description:
analyze: read the references again and rewrite art_style,
narrative_style, director_style and text_style, replacing hand edits.

template: render one of the style's two template images. Reference
images render on them (characters on the character template,
environments and objects on the environment one) and segment images
fall back on them, so finish both before any reference image. An
existing one is refused unless replace=true: replacing it changes the
look of everything rendered after.

channel_id.description: The channel whose style this is

editable_sections.description: Template prompt section overrides, keyed by section id

model.description: Model id (get_generation_options); omit for the saved choice

replace.description: template: true only when the user asked for a new image (or agreed to render a stale one again)

settings.description: Model settings: keys of its settings_schema

template_type.description: template: which template image; run once for each

name: style_generate
title: Generate for the channel style
